# New York City Bar Association

> A 20,000+ member professional organization dedicated to improving justice administration and advancing the legal profession in New York.

The NYC Bar Association serves as a hub for legal professionals, offering membership services, committee participation, continuing legal education, ethics guidance, pro-bono opportunities, and access to justice initiatives. The organization operates from its historic neoclassical building at 42 West 44th Street in Manhattan and provides both member resources and public legal services.

## About the NYC Bar Association

- [Homepage](https://www.nycbar.org): NYC Bar Association homepage: 20,000+ lawyers improving justice administration
- [About Us](https://www.nycbar.org/about-us): NYC Bar Association mission, history, and commitment to justice access
- [Leadership](https://www.nycbar.org/about-us/leadership): NYC Bar Association board of directors and executive leadership
- [Staff Directory](https://www.nycbar.org/about-us/staff): NYC Bar Association staff directory and organizational structure
- [Our Historic Building](https://www.nycbar.org/about-us/our-historic-building): Historic neoclassical building at West 44th Street, Manhattan
- [Annual Meeting](https://www.nycbar.org/about-us/annual-meeting): NYC Bar Association annual meeting with leadership remarks
- [150 Years Celebration](https://www.nycbar.org/150): NYC Bar Association 150-year anniversary celebration and history
- [Diversity, Equity & Inclusion Policy](https://www.nycbar.org/about-us/city-bar-diversity-equity-inclusion-policy): NYC Bar diversity, equity, and inclusion organizational policy

## Member Services & Committees

- [Membership](https://www.nycbar.org/member-committee-career-services/membership): NYC Bar Association membership information and dues payment
- [Member Portal Sign In](https://services.nycbar.org): Member portal sign-in for directory, CLE programs, and account access
- [Committees, Members & Career Services](https://www.nycbar.org/member-committee-career-services): Member committees, career services, law library, legal reform
- [Committee Directory & Resources](https://www.nycbar.org/member-committee-career-services/committees): NYC Bar committee directory and legal practice area resources

## Professional Development & Ethics

- [Career Development](https://www.nycbar.org/member-committee-career-services/career-development): Career advancement guidance and professional development resources
- [Ethics Panel & Advisory Opinions](https://www.nycbar.org/member-committee-career-services/ethics-overview-ethics-panel): Professional ethics panel, hotline, advisory opinions, compliance

## Public Legal Services

- [Lawyer Referral Service](https://www.nycbar.org/get-legal-help): NYC Bar Legal Referral Service to find reliable lawyers in New York

## Venue & Facilities

- [Event & Office Space Rental](https://www.nycbar.org/event-office-space-rental): 42West44 event and office space rental in historic NYC Bar building
